entries.text: Aurelia Link Hub is a static React/Vite source project for a brand link-in-bio experience.
entries.limitation: The repository is a prototype and does not include business-system integrations.

entries.text: The recorded Vercel production alias is https://aurelia-link-hub.vercel.app with a verified HTTP 200 response.
entries.limitation: The release record reflects the documented deployment and is not a substitute for ongoing uptime monitoring.

entries.text: pnpm dev starts the Vite development server defined by the project manifest.
entries.limitation: The manifest does not declare a Node.js version.

entries.text: pnpm check maps to TypeScript no-emit validation.
entries.limitation: The command validates TypeScript but does not replace user-flow testing.

entries.text: pnpm build creates the configured static build output and server bundle.
entries.limitation: The repository does not define an automated CI workflow.

entries.text: Smart-link clicks dispatch an aurelia:smart-link browser CustomEvent and update a local event-preview drawer.
entries.limitation: No analytics provider is configured by this source.

entries.text: The featured campaign area uses two manual previous/next controls and a polite live position indicator.
entries.limitation: Campaign copy and destinations are demonstration content.

entries.text: The source contains two product cards and public stock-media URLs that were verified on the final production alias.
entries.limitation: Product names, prices, and destinations are demonstration content.

entries.text: The newsletter form validates a non-empty email field locally and presents inline success feedback without an external submission.
entries.limitation: A newsletter provider, consent language, and delivery workflow are outside this repository.

entries.text: The Vercel configuration defines Vite, a frozen pnpm install, the pnpm build command, dist/public output, and a catch-all SPA rewrite.
entries.limitation: This configuration does not itself establish an ongoing Git-linked deployment relationship.

entries.text: Outbound destinations and newsletter processing remain placeholder prototype content.
entries.limitation: Business owners must provide approved production content and integrations.

entries.text: The package manifest declares an MIT license.
entries.limitation: No top-level LICENSE file was found during README reconnaissance.
